title: Realisation clarifies an earlier version
meaning: Openness to another perspective can support revising your shared view while recognising why an earlier version continues to attract you emotionally.
text: An earlier version can remain appealing after an important discovery. Judgement in the physical position of Ajna suggests reconsidering an explanation after realisation. The Fool in energy supports freely considering another perspective. The Devil in emotions experiences a compelling image’s strong pull. You may already understand an older thought’s limits while still finding it difficult to release pleasure that the image gave you both.

For example, you discuss a successful shared result and notice that you explained it through an exceptional ability to guess each other’s thoughts. Notes also show several detailed clarifications. **Important realisation can change a version while understanding its appeal.** You reconsider the explanation and include actual conversations. A beautiful image of faultless agreement still delights you. Another perspective reveals clarification’s value without devaluing closeness. Your view gains more accurate foundations, while a powerful feeling can remain an experience without being assigned responsibility for checking every circumstance behind the result.

The risk is returning to a beautiful version whenever accuracy seems less impressive. Openness helps notice other appealing qualities within actual experience. Your view develops when delight can concern a discovered connection beyond an image’s exceptional character alone. Realisation then need not remove pleasure: it leaves room to distinguish an impression’s strength from the foundations of an explanation.
